reasoning: Three vertex‑disjoint cliques of size 3 contain exactly 3 × 3 = 9 vertices. Since the graph must have 16 vertices, it is impossible to partition all 16 vertices into only three 3‑vertex cliques, so no such graph exists.
cot_trace: We need 16 vertices partitioned into cliques of size 3, three cliques => total vertices 9, but we have 16 vertices, impossible. So UNSAT.
